sb_prompt: WHAT HOBBIES DO YOU HAVE IN YOUR SPARE TIME?  DO THEY INCLUDE ANY HANDICRAFTSWOODWORKING?
turns: So, what hobbies do you have in your spare time?
Well, I've been doing a lot of knitting lately.
That's really interesting! I used to knit a lot when I was younger, but I haven't had much time for it lately.
I find it really relaxing, you know?
What kind of things do you usually knit?
Mostly scarves and sweaters, but I've been trying to branch out into other projects too.
That's great! I remember knitting a lot of blankets when I was younger, but I haven't done that in a while.
I actually just finished a blanket for my niece, it was a lot of fun to make.
Yeah, it was a lot of work but it was worth it to see her face light up when she opened it.
I'm glad to hear that knitting is relaxing for you.
Yeah, it's definitely a stress reliever for me.
What about you, do you have any other hobbies besides knitting?
I also like to do some woodworking in my spare time.
That's really interesting! What kind of woodworking projects do you usually work on?
Mostly just small projects like birdhouses and picnic tables, but I'm hoping to tackle something bigger soon.
That sounds like a lot of fun!
Yeah, it's a great way to unwind after a long day at work.
What kind of woodworking projects would you like to tackle?
I'm thinking about building a deck for my backyard.
That sounds like a really exciting project!
What inspired you to take up woodworking as a hobby?
I've always been interested in it and finally had the time and space to start doing it a few years ago.
I also like to read in my spare time.
That's great, I love reading too!
What kind of books do you like to read?
I usually read a mix of fiction and non-fiction, but lately I've been really into mystery novels.
I've been reading a lot of true crime lately too.
That's really interesting, I've never been into true crime myself.
Yeah, it's definitely a great way to unwind after a long day at work.
Yeah, it's definitely a great way to unwind after a long day at work.
What's your favorite true crime book or podcast?
My favorite true crime book is 'The Devil in the White City' by Erik Larson.
That sounds like a really interesting book, I'll have to check it out.
And my favorite true crime podcast is 'Serial'.
Yeah, it's definitely a great way to unwind after a long day at work.
